criteria.succeeds: the business context document lists the architectural drivers and the developer confirmed them
criteria.fails: the document lists implementation details as drivers, or modelling starts while it is missing

criteria.succeeds: the use case catalogue holds a White use case per stakeholder goal, each Blue one realising exactly one White
criteria.fails: a use case names a technology, or a Blue case restates the guarantees of its White parent

criteria.succeeds: the C4 views exist and each container traces to a driver in the business context document
criteria.fails: a container has no driver behind it, or mixes several runtime responsibilities

criteria.succeeds: an ADR exists per significant decision, each listing its considered options and its outcome
criteria.fails: a decision in the views has no ADR, or an ADR lists a single option or no consequences

criteria.succeeds: the domain model exists and the contracts and views name only concepts it holds
criteria.fails: a contract or view names a domain concept that the model does not hold
